run_motif_video_pipeline: run the MotifVideoPipeline to generate a video from a text prompt with configurable dimensions and inference steps
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the T5Gemma2Encoder with attention masks
prepare_denoising_latents: prepare random noisy latents for the diffusion denoising loop with specified batch size, frames, height, and width
denoise_video_latents: denoise video latents through the transformer denoising loop with guider-based conditioning and scheduler stepping
decode_latents_to_video: decode denoised video latents back to pixel space using the VAE and postprocess into PIL or numpy output format
